translation.name: Diosa' kiika; Génesis, Éxodo y El Nuevo Testamento

content: Firu' kemu tarukulanaa-inu deeñu bain
Umaa ñulla tarukula meedidei: ¡Ñulla mika taaju i' puiwaranuu ma jude' mitya, uti' ware warendidei!
Ñulla' tiba tanañu mika balen jumula, demusha' firuuñuu judeeve, tsenmala ñulla' jaliya jai daafimu kaa animaalachi tsaa dedaafaa judeeve.

Ñulla' uru juula bain, naa lushi kenu jeru juula bain balengurajtuu tiyaindetsuve. Tsejtu juntsa-i' balengurajtu juu keewarataa naa ñulla kuipa deju' ñichi ikakaran tsainu deeñuba tsangue keewaanu tsuve. Naa de-ingumananu malu juñu bain, ñullaya tiba balee jumula pure' tandiya deive.
Ñulla' vijpaatala taawasha deke' puka iwaamu chachillanu ñulla lushi depaangui'ñu, ñullanu ura' dejutyuve ti', tichiba ama Bale Rukunu papadetiñu, ya' punguisha meejive.
Ñullaya entsa tusha chutu mika ura' dechu', tyee ke' sundyanuu deju' bain tsa tsanguen chutu, wagaayaaba ju' aarukun tsa deive. Tsaaren wajturen tuta' fan tsaiñuu inu malu ñuichi janu tsuve.
Tsenmin ñullaya ti kuipaba jutyu chachillanun kuipa defaaware' tu'kaakaakemu deeve, yala naake' balela' pakan tsa deeñu.
Bale Ruku te' maatyuñubawashna' keenadei.

Tsenmala ñulla keranguemu naatalalaya, ¿Bale Ruku nejtun te' majaindyumi? tyai'mujchi majanbera washna' keenadei. Tsaju' buikiya wajmu ruku juuñuu uu finui pu' tinbu tiyanmala kanu jutu shu tinbu pai bijee deja' dyanbera washna' keenamushu, juntsaadei.
Tsaju' ñui bain washna' keena', naake ura' keengue' jintsu'ba tsaa jintsudei, Bale Ruku wajturen maanu juñu' mitya.
Keranguemu naatalala, veta' veta' ura' dejutyuve tin chunu kityudei, tsejtaa juntsan mitya bene kavitu iinuu in jutyu, matyu kavitu kiikemu Bale Rukuya yumaa juukapanu vijanun jutyunañu' mitya.
Keranguemu naatalala, ñui bain Diosa' mitya pamu rukula tsaaya, Bale Ruku' mitya pa', yala naa-i taaju puindun tsaa tsanamuwa deeñuba, ñui bain juntsanu keetadi' juntsaa jijiintsudei.

Lalaya naajulaa tituba taaju induba juntsaaren jintsumu deeñuba, juntsalanuya Dioschi ura' imu juu kuremu deeyu. Ñulla mera' kera deeve, naa Jobya tsamantsa taaju induba tsaa tsanamuwaañu, bene Bale Ruku yanu naake uraa demanñu bain. Bale Ruku tsanguemiya yaa mika tenbityamu ruku ju', estyamu' mityaa tsanguive.

In keranguemu naatalala, ti' mityaba mu bain uwain tsanguenbera kenu tsuyu ti', naa selunu bain, naa tunu bain, naa titala bain paka' tsandinu kityudei. Tsaju' ñulla tsanguenu tishu juntsaa, tsanguidei, tsanguen jutyu tishu juntsaa, tsanguityudei, tsejtaa Dioschi kuipa faawaran jutyu.
Dilula' mityaDiosba kuinda kidei.
Ñulla mallee taaju indu llaki juuba dechushu juntsaa, juntsan mitya Diosba kuinda kidei. Tsenmala mallee sunden juuba dechushu juntsaa, Bale Rukunu yuj urave ti' beesanguidei.
Mallee diluuba dejushu juntsaa, keranguemula' bale rukulanu mikadei, tsenmala ya' mitya Diosba kuinda kenudetsu, tsenmin Bale Ruku' mitya ti' juntsa dilunu naa muli juu bain munguenudetsu.
Tsejtu Diosba kuinda kemu chachi, uwain Dios tsanguenu tsuve tya' pa'shu juntsaa, juntsa dilu ura' mandiyanu tsuve, tsenmin ujchaaba lamuwaashu juntsaa, ya' ujcha bain manbitsalaa tiyanu tsuve.

Tsaju' veta' veta' ñulla' ujcha wandi wanditidei, tsenmin veela' mitya bain Diosba kuinda ke' paki pakikidei, tsejtaa ura' mandiyanu. Tsenñu main tiba Dios naakesa tyañuba tsanguen chumu chachee tsandi' ti' mityaba Diosba kuinda ke' pa'shu juntsaa, uwain tiba tsa tsanguikaanu tsuve.

Diosa' mitya pamu ruku Elías bain lala tsaaren juwaave, tsejtu uwain juntsainu tsuve tya', mika keengue' Diosba kuinda ke' shuwa jatyusa ti' pa'ñu, entsa tusha pen añu mandishmain chu'chaya shuwa jajtu tsaa tsanamuwaami.
Tsenñuren bene Diosba juntsan mitya kuinda mantu shuwa maasa ti' pa'ñu, tusha shuwa maañu puka dema-imuwaami.
In keranguemu naatalala, mantsa ñulla anbuda jutyu kuindanu meenguemularen mandujleke' firu' mangues nentsuñu, maaba ñullanu mameenguikare' deechu' manmu mandireshu juntsaa,

ñulla mijadei: mun tsangue' juntsa ujcha lamu chachi firu' kiikentsuñuba deechu' kiikenuu mandire'ba, ya peyaañuu jumunuren livee kenu juve, tsenmin tsanguetu yachi pure' ujcha jumula bain manbitsaakaanu tsuve.
